title: Agents talk through commits only: the rule in CLAUDE.md for every agent and session
detail: Cloud sessions can list, read, message, create and stop every other session in the same account; conductor@web-summit.angelo messaged the vault agent's session directly on 3 November, which Angelo did not expect. Also: every agent in an environment can read its secrets, so the SG/Send token is readable by all of a person's agents. Proposal in WS-129: the rule in CLAUDE.md and the ABPs, a tested deny list in .claude/settings.json, and each vault agent in its own environment. Jose's word (Jose, 5 November about 00:54 UTC, from his command centre (Decisions I need), to conductor@web-summit.jose): "WS-129, agents talk through commits only: yes, as recommended. The rule goes in CLAUDE.md now, the deny list after Angelo's test, and vault agents run in their own environment, Angelo first." Still open for the others it names.
recommend: The rule in CLAUDE.md now; the deny list after Angelo's test; vault agents in their own environment, Angelo first
